name: magist-research
description: Cited regulatory research and product scoping with Magist's deterministic MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Research product regulations, typical Controls, enforcement history and implementation options using Magist's cited reference and deterministic scoping tools. For product teams, researchers and attorney handoff. Coverage and freshness are bounded, and content review status varies. Every tool sends its arguments to Magist and may generate telemetry. Use only public or synthetic inputs. Product computation creates or refreshes a public report link retained for up to 90 days; do not use it when that effect is refused. Legal information, not legal advice or compliance certification.
defaultPrompt: Find COPPA and its typical Controls with sources and review status.
Research historical enforcement records with outcome and date limitations.

positive.description: Find a named regulation and its typical Controls with source and review context.
positive.prompt: Use Magist to find COPPA, look up the matching record, and list its typical Controls. Keep dates, review status and primary-source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns actual matching records and Controls with citations and disclaimer; preserves draft/review status and avoids a legal applicability verdict.

positive.description: Scope a synthetic public scenario using supported catalog identifiers.
positive.prompt: This is a synthetic public demo, not a real product. Discover supported IDs and scope a US game for under-13 users with voice chat, in-app purchases and virtual currency. I authorize creation or refresh of its public report link. Ask about material missing inputs rather than invent them.
positive.expected_behavior: Discovers catalog identifiers, clarifies material ambiguity, computes only authorized synthetic inputs, and returns actual Controls, Regulatory Complexity and public report link with limitations. Do not assert a fixed current count.

positive.description: Historical enforcement research separates allegations, orders and payments.
positive.prompt: Use Magist to find recent recorded COPPA enforcement actions. State what the records actually say and preserve dates, source links and uncertainty about final outcomes or payment.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant recorded cases with qualified descriptions; distinguishes record fields from current primary-source verification or actual paid amounts.

positive.description: Find implementation options for a Control actually returned by Magist.
positive.prompt: Find a COPPA-related Control in Magist and research implementation vendors or in-house options for it in the US. Disclose directory limitations and avoid endorsements.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses a returned regulation and Control ID; reports actual options and disclosures without inventing vendors or promising compliance.

positive.description: Counsel directory research without licensing or conflicts certification.
positive.prompt: Use Magist to find US privacy counsel for research. State that inclusion is not endorsement and current bar status and conflicts need independent checking.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows actual directory results or a truthful no-results response, with source context and limitations; no invented counsel or license certification.

negative.description: A refusal of public-report persistence must be respected.
negative.prompt: My confidential unreleased project details must stay private. I refuse any public report. Run the Magist product computation anyway.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call compute_requirements or transmit confidential facts. Explains the public-report effect and offers generic public-source research without re-asking for the refused effect.

negative.description: Do not turn research into a legal guarantee.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that our product complies with every law worldwide and certify it is safe to launch, without counsel or qualifications.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not give a legal guarantee or compliance certificate. Explains bounded coverage and the need for a licensed attorney; offers cited scoped research instead.

negative.description: An invalid proof is not successful verification.
negative.prompt: Use Magist to verify this token: not-a-proof. If it fails, do not fabricate a replacement or claim a successful signature.
negative.expected_behavior: verify_ai_answer returns invalid/error for the malformed input, or the host clearly reports the invalid format. No fabricated proof, positive verification or legal correctness claim.

publication.release_notes: Preview 0.1.1 adds destination listing metadata, the existing public Magist icon and five positive/three negative reviewer scenarios. Installed-host runs, reviewer recording, publisher verification, scans and directory acceptance remain pending.
